name: scholarly-agent-suite
description: Evidence-first academic research and writing agent: one Skill with modules for execution planning, research evidence, scholarly writing, publication strategy, pre-submission peer review, prose polishing in any language, and scholarly translation between any languages.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-first academic research, writing, and publication strategy
interface.longDescription: An evidence-first academic agent with seven modules for execution planning, research evidence, scholarly writing, publication strategy, pre-submission peer review, prose polishing, and scholarly translation. One Skill loads the modules needed for each request and passes data through versioned JSON protocols under a shared academic integrity policy.
defaultPrompt: Use $scholarly-agent to help with this scholarly task.
Help me turn this research idea into a manuscript and find a journal.
Improve this manuscript and tell me where to submit it.
